Latest mark-sheet (मार्कशिट)

School leaving and/or college/university transfer certificate (शाळा/कॉलेज सोडल्याचा दाखला)

Board certificate (बोर्ड दाखला)

Caste certificate (जातीचा दाखला)

Income certificate (उत्पन्नाचा दाखला)

Three (3) passport size photos. Make sure all these photos are same. (३ पासपोर्ट साईज फोटो)

Caste verification certificate (if asked) (जात पडताळणी दाखला - विचारल्यास)

Domicile certificate (if asked) (रहिवासी दाखला - विचारल्यास)

Nationality certificate (if asked) (राष्ट्रीयत्वाचा दाखला - विचारल्यास)

Optional (good to have) documents (खालील कागदपत्र असल्यास उत्तम):

Identity proof (School / College / University I-Card OR Election Card OR Passport OR Driving Licence OR Aadhaar Card OR PAN Card etc.) (ओळखपत्र)

Address proof (Light-bill, Passport, Aadhaar etc.) (राहत असल्याचा पुरावा)

Age proof (mentioned in your school leaving and/or college/university transfer certificate) (वयाचा पुरावा)

NOC (No Objection Certificate)

Studen's bank account passbook (विद्यार्थ्याचं बँक पासबुक)

Additional (good to have) Things:

Two envelops

Postage stamps

Revenew stamps

Both blue and black ink pens

Pencil and eraser

Additional xerox (at least two copies) of all the documents you have

Stapler with enough staple pins

Eligibility (पात्रता)

10th (for Junior college education)

11th (for 12th education)

12th (for Senior college education)

Graduation (for Post Graduation education)

Post Graduation (for M.Phil, Ph.D etc. education)

Graduation (or last year of graduation) (for competitive - UPSC/MPSC/Bank Probationary Officer/Staff Selection etc. - examination you will have to take admission in college, university)

Distance - from your current location to the expected hostel location. The more the distance, the more chances to get admission in hostel.
(विद्यार्थ्याचं राहत ठिकाण अन तुमची शाळा/कॉलेज/विद्यापीठ यातील अंतर)

Need - It is important that you 'really' need the hostel. Hostel rector checks your need also.
(विद्यार्थ्याची हॉस्टेलची निकड/गरज किती आहे)

Income - The income limit mentions in the form.
(घरातील एकूण उत्पन्न)

Should be able to pay hostel's monthly/yearly fees (not always but if mentioned in the form. Mostly applicable to private hostels only.)

Selection Criteria (निवडीचे निकष)

Selection criteria mostly based on the eligibility points.

You should first get an admission.

Distance matters the most in selection criteria. For example if you are leaving in Nagpur, and got admission in Pune, then you fit in the criteria.

Your hostel need gets checked before and during the process. If at any stage, concern person noticed that you are not in need of hostel, your application will be rejected.

Should be able to pay hostel's monthly/yearly fees (if mentioned in the form)

Quantity - There are always limited seats available in all hostels. That means, the selection happens on first-come first-serve basis. So you have to apply as soon as possible.

Gender - If a hostel is specifically for females, then only female candidates can apply.
If a hostel is only for males, then only male candidates can apply.
If a hostel is for both males and females, then both male and female candidates can apply.

Income - Hostels run for needy candidates.
